---
name: Propose a rule
about: Something that should be a rule and is not
labels: enhancement
---

## Statement

What must be true, in one or two sentences. This is the rule.

## Rationale

What goes wrong without it. Not a restatement of the statement — the rationale
is what decides whether the rule survives an argument.

## Enforcement

What would catch a violation: a named tool or gate, or `review`. A rule
nothing can enforce is not disqualified, but say so plainly rather than
implying a check.

## Deviation

`never`, `permitted`, or the conditions under which it may be broken.

## Who would cite it

The tiers exist to be cited from code, tests and documents. Name something in a
repository that would cite this rule. A rule nothing would cite is a proposal
about how to work rather than a standard.
